schema_status: Proposed CMS import snapshot, not a claim that production API already implements it.

ua: autoshrot: navigation targets normalized to CMS IDs car/statuses/removal. Current DOM IDs are dismantling-vehicle/dismantling-statuses/dismantling-parts; preserve them as aliases when migrating. The current hero and nested workflow do not have the proposed hero/workflow IDs yet.

autoshrot extensions: navigation.label preserves the accessible navigation title; car/statuses/removal.eyebrow preserve the current section labels; anchor_aliases documents old-to-new fragment IDs. Section numbering remains presentation. Current images are decorative (image_alt="").

tecdoc extensions: hero.secondary_cta_text/secondary_cta_target and hero.details preserve the current second action and three badges; sections[].eyebrow and sections[].blocks[] {id,title,paragraphs} preserve original paragraphs and nested about articles. Only #tecdoc-features is currently a section anchor; tecdoc-about/tecdoc-rmi are proposed IDs.

tecdoc.license is a required proposed CMS extension for the visible 25 EUR/month price, annual upfront-payment terms, trial badge and trial terms. These are license pricing, not CRM subscription packages. Hero has no image in the current page. Numeric statistics preserve their + and translated million/thousand suffixes.

tecdoc.cta describes the current TecDoc request form. button_target is the local form anchor, not a purchase endpoint; submission retains requested_product=tecdoc. Shared form labels, validation and success copy remain in the exported UI dictionary.

websites.gallery.items.free: no existing example-free.{png,jpg,jpeg,webp,avif} matched by the current glob. Export image="" preserves the present placeholder; upload/select a real example in CMS before replacing it.

websites.gallery.items.practical: no existing example-practical.{png,jpg,jpeg,webp,avif} matched by the current glob. Export image="" preserves the present placeholder; upload/select a real example in CMS before replacing it.

websites.gallery.items.maximum: no existing example-maximum.{png,jpg,jpeg,webp,avif} matched by the current glob. Export image="" preserves the present placeholder; upload/select a real example in CMS before replacing it.

websites overview: homepage.website_development_section.website_image_src="/imgs/websites/site_2.png" is preserved in the base export and must become the runtime source. Current /websites resolves a separate glob image "overview"="", so it can render a placeholder even when the configured CMS/homepage source exists.
websites image files not matched by the current overview/example glob: site_2.png. No file was assigned to an example by assumption.

websites extensions: gallery.section_title and pricing.section_description retain the current headings/introduction. Three gallery entries retain plan IDs/names/template labels; they currently have no external URLs or invented preview images.

websites.pricing.services[].plans[tariffId].text is a proposed optional full-label override for plan-specific wording (vehicleCatalogLimited, mscoreLimited, mscoreFull). Render this override instead of services[].text when present. note remains a separate optional annotation and is currently empty. included is an explicit exported boolean; CMS must not infer it from service order.

websites paid plans are currently displayed as one-time setup prices (practical=300 USD, maximum=500 USD) plus the exact localized extra_payments_note="+$10 на місяць за 10 тис. запитів". Preserve both; do not change setup billing_type to monthly or infer a further unlisted price. The UI currently selects a plan ID and scrolls to #trial-request; the form sends that ID as website_package.
Website setup tariffs are independent of the unpublished homepage.vortex_pricing_section CRM packages. Do not use website tariffs or the existing calculator to fabricate those future package prices.

limitations: No real CMS endpoint, authenticated preview token or staging response was provided or verified. No content was published.
New structured fields are proposed extensions. The current site still reads local source files and code, and does not consume all fields in this export.
homepage.vortex_pricing_section remains visible=false and plans=[] in all5 locales. No commercial packages or prices invented.
Website prices0/300/500 USD and TecDoc25 EUR/month are existing code values, not newly approved commercial offers. Retain current annual advance-payment and extra request charges.
Subpage website image glob has no matching files. Three gallery images and overview are empty placeholders; homepage site_2.png is a real, used image.
Demo blog20 summaries and one5locale base article are reference/demo-blog.json only, excluded from content.json. Do not import as real published posts.
seo.blog describes intended live defaults; actual demo pages remain noindex,follow. Current SEO otherwise uses code and current default96x96 logo.
Presentation, CSS, animations, conditional sticky backgrounds and responsive header transitions remain client code, not arbitrary CMS HTML.
Public media URLs are preserved. Move them to absolute CMS URLs consistently on import if hosting changes. No webp/thumb variants have been generated.
Media alt strings preserve supplied/rendered copy; empty alts can be intentional decorative images. Sources list includes code-only assets as well as publishable content.
